records.name: Kliff
records.role: Protagonist, acting leader of the Greymanes
records.summary: The main playable character: a versatile melee fighter with swords, spears, axes and grappling.
records.body: Kliff carries the critical path of the story; [[character:damiane]] and [[character:oongka]] become playable later but the main missions stay with him. He leads what is left of the [[faction:greymanes]] after the attack at their camp.
facts: Fights with swords, spears, axes and unarmed grapples
The 2.0 Enhanced update reworked parts of his story and dialogue

records.name: Damiane
records.summary: A fast, fragile fighter with a rapier and a pistol who joins as a playable character around chapter 3.

records.name: Oongka
records.summary: A brute-force melee fighter who becomes playable around chapter 7.

records.name: Myurdin
records.role: Antagonist, leader of the Black Bears
records.summary: Leader of the Black Bears, the faction that shattered the Greymanes in the opening attack.

records.name: Rhett
records.summary: Hernand's armour merchant; the first place to buy a full plate set.
